two_repairs.wrapped-line: The caller's block split one logical line across two entries. A PAIR (i, i+1) is an eligible site iff: both entries are non-empty; entry i+1 carries NO indentation of its own; entry i OPENS a bracket or a quote; entry i+1 is a NET CLOSER that returns the delimiter state to exactly what entry i started from. The pair is then rejoined, with one space after a token that needs a right operand ([,+-*/%=<>&|?!:]$) and with nothing otherwise — so `call(one,` + `two)` becomes `call(one, two)`, `foo(` + `bar)` becomes `foo(bar)`, and `"hello ` + `world"` becomes `"hello world"`.
two_repairs.paired-indent: The block lost its block-level indentation: EVERY non-empty block entry is flush left while the range it replaces carries at least one indent, and the block spans >= 2 entries. Each entry then takes the indent of the replaced line it stands in for (k-th block entry <- k-th replaced line), a block that grew keeping the range's last indent.

algorithm.scanner: scanDelimiters is language-agnostic on purpose: ()[]{} depth plus the double-quote and backtick quotes with backslash escapes. A SINGLE QUOTE is deliberately not tracked (string delimiter in some languages, an apostrophe in prose); leaving it out can only make a line look LESS open, and an open line is only ever a CANDIDATE.
the_three_refusals: arraysEqual(block, range) -> return immediately: a block that already EQUALS the range it replaces is a successful exact edit and is never touched, even when it carries a wrap-shaped pair (proved by the 4th case).
>1 eligible wrap site -> repair NEITHER and splice the block exactly as written: two candidate splits are an ambiguous request (proved by the negative control).
append/prepend never reach the pass at all: neither has a replaced range to prove a mangling against.
algorithm.declared_bound: The pass is heuristic by nature and this bound is stated rather than implied: it distinguishes a wrapped line from a DELIBERATE column-0 continuation by delimiter evidence (the fragment must close what the wrapper opened) plus the uniqueness gate. Prose carrying a genuinely unmatched bracket followed by an unindented line can therefore read as a wrap candidate. It never deletes, never reorders, and never fires on a block it cannot decide.
